selection: First qualified distinct compositions in seeded full training permutation, per size bin. First8 FIT, next4 source-head held out. Neutral Q0, multiplicity1, C/H present, unchanged reference graph/geometry assay. No generated outcomes or energy ranking.
utility: 0.8*graph_supported+0.2*geometrically_supported; all attempts including validator failures retained
training_objective: Actual/shuffled: maximize unnormalized source marginal IS utility difference with leave-one-out centering, minus .01*treeKL. NLL: minimize reference coordinate NLL per DOF plus same .01*treeKL. All use the same per-condition trust mixture and30 epochs; no validation selection.
shuffle: One frozen within-composition permutation, seed31031+seed_index*1000+condition_index; same reward multiset.
primary: Fresh head-held-out graph pass rate: actual vs fixed and shuffled, separately for both frozen decoders. Report paired draw intervals and composition-stratified intervals, utility, geometry, diversity and total preparation/inference cost.
pilot_gate: Proceed only if actual point gain over fixed AND shuffled in both decoders, pooled paired-draw95 lower bounds positive for both comparisons, and pooled distinct connectivity per attempted draw no worse than fixed by more than2pp. Also report composition uncertainty; this is a development gate, not a submission or confirmatory claim.
fail_rule: No parameter sweep, trust relaxation, reward change or sample budget growth based on fresh outcomes. All negatives retained; offline IS gain does not pass.
scope: New source-head utility pilot on real training-corpus monomers. Decoder unchanged. No global pretraining holdout, output density, output ESS, energy-law or physics novelty claim.
